runtime.input_identity: Freeze actual input_ids and tokenizer files; do not retokenize with another runtime.

selection.ordering: seed-0 deterministic BLAKE2 ranking; never select by model outputs or test speed
selection.strata_policy: deterministic round-robin across nonempty strata; replenish from remaining eligible strata when exhausted
selection.arc_group: shared original question ID namespace across Easy and Challenge
selection.near_duplicate: normalized token 5-gram Jaccard >= 0.90, comparing task content as well as formatted prompts
selection.eval_exclusions: Complete GSM8K, HumanEval, MBPP and ARC test task pools plus frozen ShareGPT/legacy held-out prompts; MATH train also checked against its full test split
selection.reserves: Up to 128 deterministic reserves per source, separately frozen and deduplicated against all training prompts, test pools and prior reserves; report any source shortage; no replacement from a different source
selection.short_trajectory: For newly added requests only, fewer than two generated tokens cannot provide a child label: report and replace from the same-source reserve. Preserve all 8192 legacy IDs; an invalid legacy recapture stops for investigation. Infrastructure/OOM failures do not justify prompt replacement.
selection.reserve_activation: New-source reserves may replace short new trajectories; the 384 old-source reserves are retained as backup and are not automatically activated in data_v2.
selection.quota_unit: requests, not equal domain loss/token contributions

templates.legacy: Preserve original text, template and actual input IDs
templates.math: native_chat question only; no reference solution
templates.apps: raw_completion problem statement and provided starter_code; no solutions or input_output answer/test payload
templates.reasoning: native_chat task/context and original choices; Explain your reasoning briefly, then give the final option label.
templates.arc_choices: Preserve original label strings and number of choices, including 3- and 5-choice tasks

capture.stop: native EOS or output cap; no task-specific stopping
capture.legacy_reuse: Reuse only EOS-complete records whose actual prompt IDs and target configuration match; recapture cap-256 non-EOS requests from their original prompts

batch_policy.oom_fallback: Retry the same requests at batch 4->2->1; if batch 1 fails, stop without truncating or silently dropping a request
batch_policy.validation: Measure real allocated/reserved peak at each tier before full capture; current tiers are memory estimates, not GPU-validated results

freeze_after_capture: sampling fingerprints for all four epochs
new overlap audit bound to the effective request manifest; retain the planned-manifest audit separately
capture.instruction: All compared models consume the same single materialized trajectory set; no per-model regeneration

training.trainable_initialization: Construct every mode with seed 0 and the same module order; no previous drafter weights or optimizer state. Keep the architecture's zero-initialized memory output projections.
training.frozen_io_description: Frozen embedding and LM head from the target model, not parameters learned by any previous drafter
training.resume_policy: Resume only an interrupted run with the same from-scratch initialization identity, configuration, data and budget; never resume an older experimental run
training.budget_rationale: 8192 updates equal the previous per-model total of 4096 inherited baseline updates plus 4096 continuation updates; every update now uses this 16K dataset from a fresh initialization
training.anchor_sampling: uniform without replacement; use all available anchors if fewer than 64; no front/back quota
training.sampling_note: All four epochs begin in this experiment; no inherited training or sampling cursor
training.loss: uniform CE over all valid child labels in the global update; teacher-forced previous tokens
training.future_architecture_versions: Train each version from scratch with the same seed and initialization rule for shared parameters, materialized data, sampling schedule and total budget; do not inherit any preceding drafter checkpoint

core.input_policy: Remove all 300 MBPP requests; retain every other original record, input ID, template and relative order unchanged

reasoning_extension.task: explanation generation speed, not the standard multiple-choice accuracy protocol
reasoning_extension.reporting: Report independently from the 764-request core; do not pool the two panels. The historical 1064-request core included MBPP and is a different suite.

evaluation.decoding: greedy; native EOS only; no code/option-label/newline-specific stopping
evaluation.checkpoint_selection: fixed final training epoch; no per-dataset checkpoint selection
evaluation.denominators: decode tokens exclude the first token supplied by prefill; sum tokens/sum seconds; accepted children exclude bonus, committed tokens include bonus
evaluation.timing: Rotate all methods for each prompt on the same GPU; parallelize independent prompt shards; warm up outside timed records
evaluation.formal_speed_results: Use GPUs without unrelated concurrent workloads; retain GPU/runtime metadata. Shared-GPU runs are diagnostics and are not pooled with formal speed results
evaluation.bf16_target_consistency: deferred; do not change target precision in this comparison
evaluation.output_identity: Record per-request differences; this remains diagnostic and is not a BF16 validation gate
evaluation.iteration_policy: Register architecture/data/loss/budget before evaluation, retain every version's result, and do not modify individual test prompts or stopping rules based on their observed speed

execution_boundary.current_task: Finalize protocol and freeze prompt panels; do not start GPU capture or training
required_before_training: capture adapter honoring frozen input_ids and batch tiers
new capture/index with all 16384 effective trajectories
from-scratch trainer loads no previous drafter checkpoint and strictly validates same-run resume
runner reads this protocol and keeps the 764-request core separate from ARC300
execution_boundary.old_artifacts: Preserve the old 8K protocol, trajectories and results separately
